 ----Petitioner  Versus State Of Rajasthan, Through PP  ----Respondent For Petitioner(s) : Mr. Suresh Khadav

entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: For Respondent(s) : Mr. A.R. Choudhary, PP  Mr. D.D. Chitlangi  HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE KULDEEP MATHUR Order 15/03/2024 The present interim bail application under Section 439 Cr.P.C. has been filed by the petitioner on the ground that his wife Laxmi had met with an accident in which she received injuries in her left knee and the doctors have advised for arthroscopic repair of medial meniscus of left knee.
In this regard, learned counsel has placed various medical documents on record praying that the petitioner may be released on interim bail for a period of one month.
This Court, vide order dated 01.03.2024, had directed learned Public Prosecutor to submit the factual report regarding the ailment of the petitioner's wife.

In compliance of the order dated 01.03.2024, learned Public Prosecutor has produced a prescription slip dated 14.03.2024 issued by the doctor of Orthopedic Department, Mahatma Gandhi Hospital,
Jodhpur.
Learned Public Prosecutor has not disputed the factum of ailment of petitioner's wife.

Purushottam Rathi vs State Of Rajasthan (2024:Rj-Jd:12482) on 15 March, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/114722028/
1 [2024:RJ-JD:12482] (2 of 2) [CRLMB-2487/2024] Having considered the facts and circumstances of the case, so also the fact that the petitioner's wife has been advised to undergo surgery, this Court deems it just and proper to grant interim bail to the accused petitioner for a period of twenty days.

sentences.text:
Accordingly, the interim bail application filed under Section 439 Cr.P.C. is allowed and it is directed that petitioner Purushottam Rathi S/o Ramvilash Rathi arrested in connection with F.I.R.
No.363/2022, registered at Police Station Ratanada, Jodhpur City (East), for the offences under Sections 498A, 304B, 420 and 406 IPC, be released on interim bail for a period of twenty days,
provided he furnishes a personal bond in a sum of Rs.4,00,000/- with two sound and solvent sureties in the sum of Rs.2,00,000/- (out of which one surety will be a close relative of the petitioner) each to the satisfaction of learned trial court for his surrender on completion of twenty days from the date of actual release.
Let this bail application be again listed on 08.04.2024.
Learned Public Prosecutor shall be required to submit the compliance report of the order whether petitioner has surrendered or not.

(KULDEEP MATHUR),J 65-Tikam/-
